scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run build && npm --prefix mobile ci
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build && npm run bundle -w backend
scripts.check:mobile: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npx vitest run mobile
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
